title: Biz groups’ clamor: Purge 2027 budget of dubious insertions

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Major business and civil society groups are calling on Congress to ensure that no budget insertions lacking technical justification make it into the 2027 national budget, as they seek to avoid a repeat of the “ghost” and substandard flood control projects that had tainted previous spending plans. Specifically, more than 30 groups flagged over P180 billion worth of items added to the proposed budget of the Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH), the embattled agency at the center of the flood control corruption scandal.
